run_llama_inference: run a LLaMA model inference on a text prompt using the LLaMARunner class
create_llama_runner: create a LLaMARunner instance from a HuggingFace model path with optional 8bit loading
run_llama_cli: run the LLaMA inference CLI module with a model path and optional 8bit or fast kernel flags
enable_determinism: enable full determinism in transformers by setting a random seed
call_llama_runner: call the LLaMARunner with a text input and sampling parameters like temperature and top_p
